named-query.name: BC_READ_ALL_PRODUCTS
named-query.query: SELECT product FROM org.broadleafcommerce.core.catalog.domain.ProductImpl product ORDER BY product.id

named-query.name: BC_READ_PRODUCTS_BY_NAME
named-query.query: SELECT product FROM org.broadleafcommerce.core.catalog.domain.ProductImpl product JOIN product.defaultSku defaultSku WHERE defaultSku.name LIKE :name AND (product.archiveStatus.archived IS NULL OR product.archiveStatus.archived = 'N') ORDER BY product.id

named-query.name: BC_READ_AUTOMATIC_PRODUCT_BUNDLES
named-query.query: SELECT productBundle FROM org.broadleafcommerce.core.catalog.domain.ProductBundleImpl productBundle JOIN productBundle.defaultSku defaultSku WHERE productBundle.autoBundle = :autoBundle AND defaultSku.activeStartDate <= :currentDate AND (defaultSku.activeEndDate > :currentDate OR defaultSku.activeEndDate IS NULL) AND (productBundle.archiveStatus.archived IS NULL OR productBundle.archiveStatus.archived = 'N')

named-query.name: BC_READ_ACTIVE_PRODUCTS_BY_CATEGORY
named-query.query: SELECT product FROM org.broadleafcommerce.core.catalog.domain.CategoryProductXrefImpl categoryProduct JOIN categoryProduct.product product JOIN product.defaultSku defaultSku WHERE categoryProduct.category.id IN (:categoryInList) AND defaultSku.activeStartDate <= :currentDate AND (defaultSku.activeEndDate > :currentDate OR defaultSku.activeEndDate IS NULL) AND (product.archiveStatus.archived IS NULL OR product.archiveStatus.archived = 'N') ORDER BY COALESCE (categoryProduct.displayOrder,999999)

named-query.name: BC_READ_PRODUCTS_BY_CATEGORY
named-query.query: SELECT product FROM org.broadleafcommerce.core.catalog.domain.CategoryProductXrefImpl categoryProduct JOIN categoryProduct.product product WHERE categoryProduct.category.id IN (:categoryInList) ORDER BY COALESCE (categoryProduct.displayOrder,999999)

named-query.name: BC_READ_PRODUCTS_BY_OUTGOING_URL
named-query.query: SELECT product FROM org.broadleafcommerce.core.catalog.domain.ProductImpl product JOIN product.defaultSku defaultSku WHERE (product.url = :url OR product.urlKey = :urlKey) AND (defaultSku.activeEndDate > :currentDate OR defaultSku.activeEndDate IS NULL) AND (product.archiveStatus.archived IS NULL OR product.archiveStatus.archived = 'N')
